name: Qi Feeler
description: Thread the sensing soul through the meridians so that the qi flowing in nearby bodies is felt as a river.

name: Flow Taste
description: Taste the quality and depth of a foe's qi with one touch of soul.

name: Conduit Hush
description: Run a hushing current of qi round the sensing soul so that hostile touches slide off its surface.

name: Pathway Read
description: Read the open meridians of a target and mark where its qi runs thin.

name: Current Lend
description: Lend a thread of the user's qi along the sensing soul to quicken one ally's senses and strength together.

name: Knot Loosening
description: Feel for a knot in an ally's meridians left by a qi backlash and loosen it with soul-led qi.

name: Meridian Map
description: Draw the full meridian map of a foe and learn which technique its qi is gathering for.

name: Qi Needle
description: Send soul-led qi like a fine needle into the one point where a foe's flow is thinnest.

name: Reserve Reading
description: Read how much qi every cultivator in sight still holds and how fast each is spending it.

name: Seeing Current
description: streams: Sense Soul + Qi. Pour sensing soul and qi into one current that sees every weakness in a foe and drives through it in the same instant.

name: Flesh Hark
description: Hark to the body's own signals and learn how hurt or tired it truly is.

name: Bone Hearken
description: Listen through a target's bones and hear where a blow has cracked them.

name: Marrow Seat
description: Seat the guarding soul in the marrow so that a hostile touch must break the bone to reach it.

name: Sinew Read
description: Read the tension in a foe's sinews and call the next motion before it begins.

name: Body Lend
description: Lend the strength of the user's body-led soul to one ally's limbs for a short while.

name: Ache Ease
description: Ease the deep ache of strain and poison from one ally's body through the soul.

name: Wound Read
description: Read the depth and shape of a wound by the cry of the soul inside it.

name: Frame Awareness
description: Hold the whole frame of the body in awareness so that no blow lands unfelt on any part of it.

name: Flesh Ward
description: Wrap the flesh in a ward of soul that stiffens exactly where a blow is felt to fall.

name: Embodied Ken
description: Spread the sensing soul through every cell so that the body itself feels the world around it.

name: Waking Flesh
description: streams: Sense Soul + Body. Wake the soul in every part of the flesh so that the whole body feels each blow before it lands and braces against it.

name: Spark Ken
description: Flick a spark of lightning-quick sense out and read what it strikes.

name: Flash Hark
description: Catch the flash of intent in a soul at the very instant it fires.

name: Crackle Guard
description: Fill the air round the mind with crackling static that jars a hostile soul touch.

name: Impulse Read
description: Read the first impulse of a foe's nerves and name the strike before the arm moves.

name: Quick Lend
description: Lend a jolt of speed to one ally's senses so that the ally reacts in half the time.

name: Shock Ease
description: Draw the lingering numbness of a lightning shock out of one ally's nerves.

name: Instant Map
description: Flash a full map of every soul in a wide place in a single bright instant.

name: Soul Bolt
description: Hurl a bolt of lightning-quick soul force at one foe's mind faster than a guard can rise.

name: Flashing Sight
description: Light the whole field in a flash of sensing so bright that no soul can hide from it.

name: Thunder Mind
description: streams: Sense Soul + Lightning. Let sensing and lightning arrive in the same instant so that the user reads a foe and strikes through it before the foe has finished moving.
